Explanation:  
The Ground Truth Answer specifies that Frank Jevons died 5 years after the death of his predecessor. The Predicted Answer states that Jevons died in 1936 and his predecessor, Archibald Robertson, died in 1911, calculating a difference of 25 years. The Predicted Answer does not contain the correct interval as per the Ground Truth (5 years), and in fact, provides a different and incorrect answer (25 years).
